title: Rofanseilbahn Maurach
highlights: Modern aerial cable car ascending into the magnificent Rofan mountain range
Adlerhorst observation platform perched on top of the 2,039 m Gschöllkopf
AIRROFAN Skyglider thrilling passengers with speeds of up to 80 km/h
Extensive trail network with scenic family routes and challenging via ferratas
kurzbeschreibung: The Rofanseilbahn in Maurach am Achensee opens up the spectacular Rofangebirge with Skyglider and Adlerhorst.
beschreibung:
Gateway to the Rofangebirge

The Rofanseilbahn whisks visitors from Maurach on the southern shore of the Achensee up to 1,840 metres above sea level to the mountain station at the Erfurter Hütte. During the ascent, guests enjoy sweeping views over the deep blue Tyrolean sea and the Inntal.

Attractions for Explorers and Adrenaline Seekers

The Rofan plateau is a paradise for hikers, climbers, and families. Among the most striking highlights are the AIRROFAN Skyglider, which lets riders zoom towards the valley at up to 80 km/h, and the spectacular Adlerhorst viewing platform on the Gschöllkopf with panoramic views of the peaks of Tirol.
